verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, and a natural-language command layer is a fair thing to ask of a terminal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a natural-language interface. Every documented interaction uses literal shell commands (config, pickFolder, pkg, help). Apple Shortcuts integration and VoiceOver are host-platform or adjacent features, and Shortcuts' Execute Command still takes shell commands rather than natural language.
